name: Dental Care - Dental Clinic & Dentist WordPress Theme
description:
Launch Fast. Stay in Control. Build a professional dental website without starting from an empty page. Dental Care gives dental practices, specialists and web professionals a complete starting point with purpose-built demos, ready-made pages, flexible layouts and Elementor tools designed around modern patient-focused websites. 2 Complete Modern Dental Demos Built with Elementor No Elementor Pro Required Choose Your Starting Point Dental Care gives you multiple ready-made demo directions instead of forcing one generic clinic design across every type of dental practice. Choose the demo closest to the practice you’re building, import the content, then replace the branding, copy and imagery you want to change. For designers and agencies, the different starting points also make it easier to approach different dental projects without beginning from zero every time. Modern Dental Demos Dental Care includes four Modern demos built around distinct areas of dentistry. Family Dental Clinic – A versatile starting point for general and family practices offering preventive, restorative and everyday dental care. Cosmetic Dentistry – A more polished, appearance-focused direction for practices offering whitening, veneers, bonding, smile makeovers and other cosmetic treatments. Pediatric Dentist – A warmer, family-friendly design built around children’s dentistry, preventive care and creating a more welcoming patient experience. Orthodontics – Focused on braces, clear aligners, bite correction and practices dedicated to improving alignment and long-term oral health. Demo Images Included The imagery used throughout the demos is included with the imported content, so your pages arrive much closer to the live preview and are ready to customize immediately. Choose a Demo → Import → Customize Start with the design that fits the practice, keep what works and change what doesn’t. A much faster path from a fresh WordPress installation to a complete dental website. Start With the Look That Fits Every Dental Care demo includes two homepage approaches, giving you more freedom before you make a single customization. Choose a more dynamic Home Slider layout or a focused Home Image design, then shape the rest around the practice. It also gives designers and agencies another way to vary client projects without rebuilding the homepage from scratch. Complete Inner Pages. More Layouts Where It Matters A convincing dental website needs more than a polished homepage. Dental Care includes supporting layouts for About, Services, Service Details, Dentists and Team profiles, Pricing, Testimonials, FAQs, Contact, appointment-focused sections, Blog content and more. Before & After layouts also give cosmetic and treatment-focused practices a stronger way to present visible results where appropriate. Key pages include alternative designs, giving you another direction without rebuilding the structure from scratch. Choose the layout that fits the practice, mix different designs across the site, or create more variation when building for multiple dental clients. Spend less time designing routine pages and more time shaping the site around the practice. Present Treatments With More Clarity Dental Care gives important practice content the space it needs instead of forcing everything into generic page layouts. Build dedicated treatment and service pages that explain procedures clearly, answer common patient questions and guide visitors toward the next step. Use team and dentist profiles to introduce the people behind the practice, testimonials to build confidence, and Before & After content to support treatment-focused pages. Designed Around Patient Trust Choosing a dentist is personal. Visitors want to understand the treatment, see who will be caring for them and feel confident before making contact. Dental Care gives services, team profiles, testimonials, FAQs and enquiry sections proper space throughout the site. The result is a clearer path from learning about the practice to requesting an appointment or getting in touch. Built With Elementor. Extended for Dental Care. Edit the included layouts visually with Elementor, then keep building with widgets created specifically for the theme. Change content, move sections, replace imagery and create new pages without losing the design language used throughout the demos. Purpose-built widgets cover common service-business content including services, team members, testimonials, pricing, calls to action, interactive layouts and more. No Elementor Pro is required to reproduce the core Dental Care demo experience. Built With Performance in Mind Dental Care uses a modern, focused theme architecture designed to keep unnecessary overhead down. Purpose-built Elementor widgets reduce the need for extra add-ons, while the core demo experience works without Elementor Pro. Pair it with good hosting, optimized images and sensible caching for a strong performance foundation. Add a Store When the Project Needs One Most dental practices are focused on appointments and patient enquiries, but some also sell oral-care products or related items. Dental Care includes WooCommerce support when ecommerce is part of the project, without making the rest of the theme revolve around a store. Use it when you need it. Leave it alone when you don’t. description:
CiyaCare – Healthcare & Medical WordPress Theme CiyaCare is a professional WordPress theme for clinics, hospitals, doctors, and healthcare organizations. Built with Elementor, it delivers clean layouts, fast performance, and an effortless setup tailored to real medical needs. Design appointment-led pages, service directories, doctor profiles, pricing plans, a knowledge-focused blog, and a medical equipment store with WooCommerce. With one-click demo import, responsive layouts, and an intuitive options panel, CiyaCare helps you launch a reliable healthcare website in hours, not weeks. Features Overview CiyaCare is powered by Elementor for true visual building. Create pages by dragging blocks, adjusting global styles, and publishing in real time. Ready-made sections help you present services, departments, FAQs, and trust markers with clarity. For scheduling, the theme integrates the Timetable & Event Schedule plugin, ideal for clinic hours, department rotations, and upcoming events. Pair it with appointment CTAs to guide visitors from discovery to booking. CiyaCare includes full WooCommerce support, enabling a streamlined medical equipment shop with product listings, filters, and secure checkout. ACF support allows you to extend doctor profiles, service specs, and facility data without code. Under the hood, CiyaCare uses Bootstrap 5, clean W3C-compliant code, and SEO-ready structure. It’s responsive, retina-ready, and built for performance. A child theme, detailed documentation, and friendly support keep your site future-proof. Build a reliable healthcare website with ease CiyaCare is a clean, appointment-focused WordPress theme crafted for clinics, hospitals, doctors, diagnostic centers, and healthcare networks. It combines modern design with performance-first code so patients can find services, browse specialists, and book with confidence. Visual editing with Elementor Design pages visually using Elementor. Start from pre-built sections for hero, services, departments, FAQs, pricing, and testimonials. Adjust global colors and typography, then publish instantly—no coding required. Scheduling that informs and converts Use the Timetable & Event Schedule plugin to present clinic hours, doctor availability, and upcoming events in a clear, responsive grid. Add date, time, descriptions, and an “Upcoming Events” widget to keep patients informed. Sell medical equipment with WooCommerce Launch a compliant store for medical devices and supplies. CiyaCare includes shop, product, cart, checkout, and account pages styled for clarity and trust. Structured for SEO and speed Bootstrap 5, W3C-valid markup, and clean theme options deliver strong Core Web Vitals foundations. The layout system is responsive and retina-ready, ensuring consistent experiences across devices.
